> Brief description of the document.
>
> Explain in one or two sentences what this document covers and why it exists.

---

# Purpose

Describe the primary purpose of this document.

Answer the question:

> Why does this document exist?

---

# Scope

Clearly define what is covered by this document.

Also specify what is intentionally **out of scope**.

---

# Audience

Specify who should read this document.

Examples:

- All developers
- Backend developers
- Frontend developers
- DevOps engineers
- Project maintainers

---

# Related Documents

List documents that should be read together with this one.

Example:

- `../ENGINEERING.md`

- `architecture/overview.md`

---

# Contents

Write the actual documentation here.

Use descriptive headings.

Keep sections focused.

Prefer multiple short sections over one long block of text.

---

# Best Practices

When writing documentation:

- explain **why**, not only **how**;
- avoid duplicating source code;
- keep examples realistic;
- keep terminology consistent;
- write for someone who has never seen the project before;
- prefer clarity over completeness.

---

# Maintenance

This document should be updated whenever changes affect the topics described above.

Documentation should evolve together with the project.

---

**Build for years, not for weeks.**
